about_the_game:
Hellsting – Official Novel (DLC)

Format: Digital Novel (PDF)
Genre: Clean Fantasy, Epic Adventure, Companion Lore
Tags: Story-Rich, Worldbuilding, Fantasy, Non-Dark, Heroic Journey

About This DLC

Continue your adventure beyond the game—in the official companion novel of Hellsting.

This richly written epic fantasy novel expands the world and story of your RPG in a powerful new format: a full-length, beautifully structured narrative set in the very universe you’ve explored. Delivered in downloadable PDF form, Hellsting offers a deeper look into the lore, characters, and secrets behind the stolen sword and the creeping curse threatening the realm.

For generations, the kingdom protected a cursed weapon known as Hellsting. But after it is stolen, nature itself begins to twist: trees become beasts, people turn to stone, and wild magic corrupts the land. Many suspect the ancient Foul Four Siblings have returned—but the truth is far more personal.

Follow the journey of a hidden prince and a mysterious rogue named Naerel, who hides powers of telepathy and telekinesis—and a secret past that could change everything.

Inside This Novel:

  • A clean, age-appropriate fantasy filled with hope, magic, mystery, and emotional depth.

  • Epic settings from the game brought to life: mines, castles, swamps, enchanted isles, and ancient forests.

  • The origin and impact of Hellsting, the cursed blade at the heart of the story.

  • The evolving bond between the prince and Naerel—including a dramatic twist as Naerel’s true role is revealed.

  • A standalone reading experience—no game knowledge required, but even richer if you've played!

This novel is perfect for fans of heartfelt fantasy who want more than battle—they want meaning, wonder, and a touch of magic that never loses its light.

Add Hellsting – The Official Novel to your library, and bring the story home.
